data.summary: [mock LLM] The token-bucket limiter works, but its key trusts a client-controlled header and the bucket map never shrinks.

findings.title: Rate-limit key trusts the spoofable X-Forwarded-For header
findings.rationale: Any client can send a fresh `X-Forwarded-For` value on every request and get a new bucket, which bypasses the limiter.
findings.suggestion: Key on `req.ip` with Fastify's `trustProxy` configured for your load balancer.

findings.title: Bucket map grows without eviction
findings.rationale: One entry is kept per distinct key forever, so memory grows with the number of clients.
findings.suggestion: Use an LRU / TTL map, or evict buckets that have refilled completely.
